oracle_assumptions.consensus_integrity: Assumes pluggable consensus algorithms correctly identify outliers and calculate weighted averages without precision loss that could be exploited.
oracle_assumptions.liveness: Assumes a sufficient number of independent validators will claim slots and reveal their scores within the required timeframes.
oracle_assumptions.commit_reveal_security: Assumes the two-step commit-reveal process is sufficient to prevent validators from copying each other's scores.

admin_assumptions.parameter_tuning: Protocol admins (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) are trusted to set reasonable global defaults (fees, thresholds, deadlines) that don't break the protocol's economic balance.
admin_assumptions.algorithm_registry: Admins are trusted to only register consensus algorithms that have been audited and are fit for purpose.
admin_assumptions.treasury_management: Admins are trusted to manage the treasury address correctly.

trust_boundaries.external_contracts: The core protocol relies on the integrity of SapienTrust (reputation) and SapienVault (staking). Any compromise there would break the PoQ guarantees.
trust_boundaries.originator_intent: The protocol assumes Originators provide accurate IPFS CIDs for project specs; if the specs are ambiguous, consensus may be difficult to reach.
trust_boundaries.contributor_honesty: The protocol does not prevent submission of poor work, but assumes the economic penalty (slashing/no reward) is sufficient deterrence.
